description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Puka Nacua (groin) who left practice on Tuesday, is dealing with some mild soreness in his groin. The team is playing things safe.
items.impact: It doesn't sound like it's anything serious, but of course any injury needs to be monitored as the season approaches. Fantasy managers shouldn't fret too much, Nacua is still an elite pick in fantasy.
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) dealing with groin soreness

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chargers OT Rashawn Slater is dealing with a flare-up in his knee.
items.impact: Slater missed his fourth straight practice on Tuesday. His status will need to continue to be monitored.
items.title: Rashawn Slater dealing with flare-up in knee

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bears coach Ben Johnson said that Coby Bryant had surgery and will be out 4-6 months.
items.impact: It is a brutal blow for Bryant and Chicago after he signed a three-year, $40 million contract in free agency. He could miss the entire season.
items.title: Coby Bryant undergoes surgery, to miss 4-6 months

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said there will be no limitations on rookie cornerback Jermod McCoy this Thursday.
items.impact: "We expect him to play we expect him to compete and we're excited to see him play," Kubiak said. McCoy fell in the draft in April due to injury concerns from college.
items.title: Jermod McCoy (knee) to play in preseason opener without limitations

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jadarian Price was back in pads at practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Price winds up missing just a few days of practice due to a leg injury. The rookie continues to earn his reps with the first-team during training camp.
items.title: Jadarian Price (leg) back in pads at practice Tuesday

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Nick Bosa is dealing with knee tendinitis and is viewed as week-to-week, according to head coach Kyle Shanahan.
items.impact: Bosa is making his way back from an ACL tear, and the 49ers are likely being cautious with their defensive cornerstone. The 28-year-old should be monitored throughout training camp, as the injury could bleed into the regular season if there are no improvements.
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee) considered week-to-week

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak expects Fernando Mendoza to see "plenty" of playing time in the team's preseason opener on Thursday against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Kubiak made it clear coming into camp that Mendoza is the QB2 behind Kirk Cousins, and the rookie will get a chance to introduce himself to the NFL on Thursday. Mendoza could get some reps with the starters on offense as well, as Kubiak also announced that they would play at least a portion of the game.
items.title: Fernando Mendoza to see "plenty" of playing time in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori has passed his team physical.
items.impact: It is the first step to being activated from the PUP list. Emmanwori underwent an ankle procedure that has caused him to miss the start of training camp. He is on track to be good to go for the start of the season.
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) passes physical

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets coach Aaron Glenn said the starters will play in the preseason opener against the Bucs on Friday.
items.impact: Glenn said the goal is to get the starters 25-30 reps combined in the three preseason games.
items.title: Geno Smith, Jets starters to play in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bucs beat reporter Rick Stroud said Jake Browning appeared to injure his back in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Browning is expected to start in the Bucs preseason opener on Friday. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.
items.title: Jake Browning appears to injure back in practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Baker Mayfield will not play in the Buccaneers preseason opener on Friday against the Jets.
items.impact: Jake Browning is expected to start if he's good to go. He appeared to injure his back in practice on Tuesday. Mayfield will likely see some reps in the Bucs second or third preseason game.
items.title: Baker Mayfield will not play in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers told reporters Michael Pittman Jr. and DK Metcalf both have injuries.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injuries are for Pittman and Metcalf. Rodgers praised Germie Bernard and Brandon Smith for stepping up in their place. There should be an update at some point on Pittman.
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. dealing with injury per Aaron Rodgers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers told reporters DK Metcalf and Michael Pittman Jr. both have injuries.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injuries are for Metcalf and Pittman. Rodgers praised Germie Bernard and Brandon Smith for stepping up in their place. There should be an update at some point on Metcalf.
items.title: DK Metcalf dealing with undisclosed injury per Aaron Rodgers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Gonzalez did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Giardi notes that Gonzalez tweaked his ankle late in Monday's practice. He is also seeking a new contract.
items.title: Christian Gonzalez misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Daniel Jones will not play in the Colts preseason opener.
items.impact: Jones has been fully cleared to return to practice. Anthony Richardson Sr. will start with Riley Leonard starting the second half.
items.title: Daniel Jones will not play in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins went through individual drills at practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Dobbins left practice on Monday with a soft-tissue injury. It appears to have just been precautionary.
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (soft tissue) participates in individual drills Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Cameron Jordan will miss time and it could linger into the regular season.
items.impact: Jordan re-signed with the Saints this offseason. He'll be in a depth role on the defensive line when he is healthy.
items.title: Cameron Jordan (hamstring) to miss time, could linger into season

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts announced Anthony Richardson will start Thursday's preseason game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Richardson will play the first half with Riley Leonard playing the second half. They'll continue to compete for the backup job behind Daniel Jones.
items.title: Anthony Richardson Sr. to start preseason opener Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mike Evans was back at 49ers practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Evans was back in pads for the 49ers-Titans joint practice. He was sidelined with a quad injury.
items.title: Mike Evans (quad) returns to practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers RB Patrick Taylor Jr. took first-team reps in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: The 49ers backfield is depleted already with Christian McCaffrey sitting out due to tightness and both Jordan James and Kaelon Black banged up. Taylor is taking advantage of those absences.
items.title: Patrick Taylor Jr. sees first-team reps Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey remains absent from practice on Tuesday due to tightness.
items.impact: It appears to be precautionary for McCaffrey. He remains day-to-day.
items.title: Christian McCaffrey still not practicing Tuesday due to tightness

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Lamar Jackson will not play in the preseason opener on Saturday against the Eagles.
items.impact: Minter said there will be some "established players" not playing Saturday. Jackson should see some reps in the second or third preseason game.
items.title: Lamar Jackson will not play in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ravens CB Nate Wiggins was carted off the field from practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Wiggins was getting tests done after practice. Ravens coach Jesse Minter said he's optimistic but he doesn't know yet whether it's long term injury.
items.title: Nate Wiggins carted off field from practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zay Flowers returned to Ravens practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Flowers has returned to practice after missing just one practice with a quad contusion. He recently signed a four-year contract extension worth up to $140 million.
items.title: Zay Flowers (quad) back at practice Tuesday

title: Fantasy Player News
